outcome: Abnormal General Movements Assessment (GMA) findings (in writhing and fidgety ages)
cohort: The study participants were 29 late preterm and full-term infants with mild, moderate, or severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy in Philadelphia, PA.
finding: Seizures during initial hospitalization were the clinical predictor most closely associated with abnormal findings on the General Movements Assessment in the fidgety age, particularly in infants with moderate or severe HIE.
followup_time: Up to the fidgety age (approximately 4-5 months post-term)
